The pressure control Module PC 2.5 (A21) is 
intended for the control of admission (super) steam pressure by means of turbine 
governor

Module is intended for the control of admission
 Steam pressure by means of turbine Governor

This document outlines the testing procedure P1, 
which performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Farid, 
tested by
 eng. Ashraf Farid at 17 June 2003, 
revised by quality control EDEPC eng. Abdl Menem Al Emam, accepted by general 
director: eng. Aly Abd El-Whab, and approved by eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy; Head 
Sector of Talkha Power Station.

Connect jumper between point x20:90 and point 
 X20:97 in rear control cabinet side JC02 (Imitation condition: phased on)

Disconnect point x20:108. in rear control 
 cabinet side JC02 (Imitation: Trip oil ok)

Disconnect socket A31+54 typeA2121B1 in front 
 control cabinet JC03 (Imitation: digital speed)

Connect jumper between point X20:90 and point 
 X20:99 in rear control cabinet side 
 JC02 (Imitation condition: boiler in load control )

Disconnect vacuum signal point X10.3 and point 
 X10:4 in rear control cabinet side NO: JC01.

Disconnect socket A32 + 44 type D7210B2 to ability change push bottom H/A on desired pressure to position
 automatic (A) .

Inject mA Equal Admission steam pressure 
 according to the attached curve on point X20:3,4 in rear control cabinet side JC02 and follow 
 the attached curve.

Measure volt on point A21+44:27 
 typeH3202B1 & A10+60:13 a type A2804B1and A21+44:30typeH3202B1 & A21+52:3 type A2110B1
 to see that module cards tracing this 
 inject value according to the circuit diagram.
If measuring not good Chang the bad card .

Change push bottom H/A on desired pressure to 
 Automatic mode and observing departure of pressure.

When actual pressure equal desired pressure 
 the push bottom H/A on desired pressure changed automatically to hand mode 
 and the push bottom lamp light

Remove Jumper between point X20:90 and point 
 X20:97 .

Connect Signal ( trip oil not ok ) point 
 x20:108.
Connect Socket A31+54 typeA2121B1.

Remove Jumper between point X20:90 and point 
 X20:99 .
Connect Signal vacuum x10:3 , x10:4
Connect Socket A32+44 type D7210B2

Technical Procedure
Introduction
The pressure control Module PC 2.5 (A21) is 
intended for the control of admission (super) steam pressure by means of turbine 
governor
Module is intended for the control of admission
 Steam pressure by means of turbine Governor
This document outlines the testing procedure P1, 
which performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Farid, 
tested by

revised by quality control EDEPC eng. Abdl Menem Al Emam, accepted by general 
director: eng. Aly Abd El-Whab, and approved by eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy; Head 
Sector of Talkha Power Station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should be carry the
 suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes
